comment: The rules of the headless runner of PR-15 (D-1181, D-1184, D-1185). The runs start on the maps of the list in turn by seed: the seed modulo the count of the list picks the map. The fixture dungeon and the fixture hub come first, and PR-17 adds the five places of the first playable, so the bots walk, fight, and play the story scenes of each new map (exit test 5 of PR-17, D-64). A run ends as complete when the goal flag is on: the party beat the rats in the straw of the fixture hub (D-1185). PR-35 links the dungeon and the hub through the fixture overworld, so a dungeon run can reach the goal. The places of the first playable lie on the overworld of region one, which holds no way to the fixture hub, so a run that starts there ends as budget, and a crash or a softlock of it still fails the night. Each policy has its own budget (D-1259). The greedy budget is three times the longest greedy run to the goal. PR-17 measured it with the start kit of the first playable: 4,140 ticks over seeds 1 to 2000, so 12,420. The random budget stays the 2,349 of PR-15, because a random run seldom reaches the goal.
